_instructions: Choices locked based on experiment results. Run: python scripts/run_evals.py --api-key YOUR_KEY --promote
_model_why: Same precision as GPT-4o. Significantly cheaper. GPT-4o confidence always returned 0.5 (calibration issue).
_call_mode_why: One image sent once. 4x cheaper on long docs. Two-call contract_value failure was a RAG context assembly artefact, not a structural advantage of two calls.
_prompt_quality_why: Minimal prompt scored FP on complaint issue_summary â€” extracted 'Storage limits not updating after payment' but missed 'paid plan not activated'. Four-layer got it right. Delta proves Document Types configuration earns its complexity.
_retrieval_strategy_why: Contract ID is on page 1. Governing Law is on page 28. One doc-level query retrieves page 1 content for everything. Field-targeted gives each field its own retrieved section.

chunk_config._why: Word-window (500w 50w) buried the 4-line Governing Law clause inside a window mixing sections 16, 17, and 18. Embedding scored 0.67 against indemnification content â€” wrong chunk. Section-aware gives clause 17 its own 44-word chunk. Embedding scores clearly above noise.

_retrieval_k_why: K=1 fails when the top chunk is wrong and there is no backup. K=5 adds noise and lowered confidence to 60%. K=3 is the right balance.
_query_formulation_why: Generic 'What is governing_law?' scored sim=0.57 with no discrimination between chunks. Specific query including field description scored sim=0.77 and retrieved the correct section. Largest precision delta of all seven experiments.
_thresholds_why: Invoice and PO are structured, deterministic fields â€” lower threshold acceptable. Complaint and Contract have semantic fields (issue_summary, governing_law, parties) judged by LLM â€” higher threshold required.
